mn37:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde.
mn37:2.1: Atha kho Sakko devānam-indo yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Sakko devānam-indo Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn37:2.2: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānan-ti.
mn37:3.3: Evañ-ca taṃ devānam-inda bhikkhuno sutaṃ hoti:
mn37:3.5: so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya yaṃ kañci vedanaṃ vedeti,
mn37:3.6: sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharati, virāgānupassī viharati, nirodhānupassī viharati, paṭinissaggānupassī viharati;
mn37:3.7: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharanto, virāgānupassī viharanto, nirodhānupassī viharanto, paṭinissaggānupassī viharanto na kiñci loke upādiyati,
mn37:3.8: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattañ-ñeva parinibbāyati; \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn37:3.9: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn37:3.10: Ettāvatā kho devānaminda bhikkhu saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānan-ti.
mn37:4.1: Atha kho Sakko devānamindo Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyi.
mn37:5.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Bhagavato avidūre nisinno hoti.
mn37:5.3: Kin-nu kho so yakkho Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhisamecca anumodi udāhu no;
mn37:5.5: yadi vā so yakkho Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhisamecca anumodi yadi vā no ti.
mn37:6.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya evam-eva Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde antarahito devesu Tāvatiṃsesu pāturahosi.
mn37:7.1: Tena kho pana samayena Sakko devānam-indo ekapuṇḍarīke uyyāne dibbehi pañcahi turiyasatehi samappito samaṅgibhūto paricāreti.
mn37:7.2: Addasā kho Sakko devānam-indo āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ,
mn37:7.3: disvāna tāni dibbāni pañca turiyasatāni paṭippaṇāmetvā yen' āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca:
mn37:7.4: Ehi kho mārisa Moggallāna, sāgataṃ mārisa Moggallāna,
mn37:7.5: cirassaṃ kho mārisa Moggallāna imaṃ pariyāyamakāsi yadidaṃ idh' āgamanāya,
mn37:7.7: Nisīdi kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno paññatte āsane.
mn37:7.8: Sakko pi kho devānam-indo aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn37:7.9: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Sakkaṃ devānam-indaṃ āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno etad-avoca:
mn37:8.1: Yathākathaṃ pana te Kosiya Bhagavā saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ abhāsi,
mn37:8.2: sādhu mayam-pi etissā kathāya bhāgino assāma savanāyāti. --
mn37:8.3: Mayaṃ kho mārisa Moggallāna bahukiccā, mayaṃ bahukaraṇīyā,
mn37:8.4: app-eva sakena karaṇīyena api ca devānaṃ yeva Tāvatiṃsānaṃ karaṇīyena.
mn37:8.5: Api ca mārisa Moggallāna sussutaṃ yeva hoti suggahītaṃ sumanasikataṃ sūpadhāritaṃ yan-no khippam-eva antaradhāyati. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn37:8.6: Bhūtapubbaṃ mārisa Moggallāna devāsurasaṅgāmo samupabbūḷho ahosi.
mn37:8.7: Tasmiṃ kho pana mārisa Moggallāna saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu, asurā parājiniṃsu.
mn37:8.8: So kho ahaṃ mārisa Moggallāna taṃ saṅgāmaṃ abhivijinitvā vijitasaṅgāmo tato paṭinivattitvā Vejayantaṃ nāma pāsādaṃ māpesiṃ.
mn37:8.9: Vejayantassa kho pana mārisa Moggallāna pāsādassa ekasataṃ niyyūhaṃ,
mn37:8.13: Iccheyyāsi no tvaṃ mārisa Moggallāna Vejayantassa pāsādassa rāmaṇeyyakaṃ daṭṭhun-ti.
mn37:9.1: Atha kho Sakko ca devānam-indo Vessavaṇo ca mahārājā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ purakkhatvā yena Vejayanto pāsādo ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu.
mn37:9.2: Addasāsuṃ kho Sakkassa devānam-indassa paricārikāyo āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ,
mn37:9.3: disvāna ottapamānā hirīyamānā sakaṃ sakaṃ ovarakaṃ pavisiṃsu.
mn37:10.1: Seyyathā pi nāma suṇisā sasuraṃ disvā ottapati hirīyati,
mn37:10.2: evam-evaṃ Sakkassa devānam-indassa paricārikāyo āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ disvā ottapamānā hirīyamānā sakaṃ sakaṃ ovarakaṃ pavisiṃsu.
mn37:10.3: Atha kho Sakko ca devānam-indo Vessavaṇo ca mahārājā āyasmantaṃ Mahāmoggallānaṃ Vejayante pāsāde anucaṅkamāpenti anuvicarāpenti:
mn37:10.4: idam-pi mārisa Moggallāna passa Vejayantassa pāsādassa rāmaṇeyyakaṃ,
mn37:10.5: idam-pi marisa Moggallāna passa Vejayantassa pāsādassa rāmaṇeyyakan-ti. --
mn37:10.6: Sobhat' idaṃ āyasmato Kosiyassa yathā taṃ pubbe katapuññassa,
mn37:10.7: manussā pi kiñcid-eva rāmaṇeyyakaṃ diṭṭhā evam-āhaṃsu:
mn37:10.9: ta-y-idaṃ āyasmato Kosiyassa sobhati yathā taṃ pubbe katapuññassāti.
mn37:11.2: Atibāḷhaṃ kho ayaṃ yakkho pamatto viharati,
mn37:11.4: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno tathārūpaṃ iddhābhisaṅkhāraṃ abhisaṅkhāsi yathā Vejayantaṃ pāsādaṃ pādaṅguṭṭhakena saṅkampesi sampakampesi sampavedhesi. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn37:11.5: Atha kho Sakko ca devānam-indo Vessavaṇo ca mahārājā devā ca Tāvatiṃsā acchariyabbhutacittajātā ahesuṃ:
mn37:11.6: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
mn37:11.7: samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā, yatra hi nāma dibbaṃ bhavanaṃ pādaṅguṭṭhakena saṅkampessati sampakampessati sampavedhessatīti.
mn37:12.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Sakkaṃ devānam-indaṃ saṃviggaṃ lomahaṭṭhajātaṃ viditvā Sakkaṃ devānam-indaṃ etad-avoca:
mn37:12.2: Yathākathaṃ pana te Kosiya Bhagavā saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ abhāsi,
mn37:12.3: sādhu mayam-pi etissā kathāya bhāgino assāma savanāyāti. --
mn37:12.4: Idhāhaṃ mārisa Moggallāna yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃ, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsiṃ. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho ahaṃ mārisa Moggallāna Bhagavantaṃ etad-avocaṃ:
mn37:12.5: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānan-ti.
mn37:13.1: Evaṃ vutte mārisa Moggallāna Bhagavā maṃ etad-avoca:
mn37:13.4: Evañ-ce taṃ devānam-inda bhikkhuno sutaṃ hoti:
mn37:13.6: so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya yaṃ kañci vedanaṃ vedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā,
mn37:13.7: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharati, virāgānupassī viharati, nirodhānupassī viharati, paṭinissaggānupassī viharati;
mn37:13.8: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharanto, virāgānupassī viharanto, nirodhānupassī viharanto, paṭinissaggānupassī viharanto na kiñci loke upādiyati,
mn37:13.9: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattañ-ñeva parinibbāyati;
mn37:13.10: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn37:13.11: Ettāvatā kho devānam-inda bhikkhu saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānan-ti.
mn37:13.12: Evaṃ kho me mārisa Moggallāna Bhagavā saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ abhāsīti.
mn37:14.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Sakkassa devānam-indassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya evam-evaṃ devesu Tāvatiṃsesu antarahito Pubbārāme Migāramātu pāsāde pāturahosi. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn37:14.2: Atha kho Sakkassa devānam-indassa paricārikāyo acirapakkante āyasmante Mahāmoggallāne Sakkaṃ devānam-indaṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mn37:14.3: Eso nu te mārisa so Bhagavā satthā ti. --
mn37:14.4: Na kho me mārisā so Bhagavā satthā,
mn37:14.5: sabrahmacārī me eso. āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno ti. --
mn37:14.7: yassa te sabrahmacārī evaṃ mahiddhiko evaṃ mahānubhāvo,
mn37:14.8: aho nūna te so Bhagavā satthā ti.
mn37:15.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Bhagavantaṃ etad-avoca:
mn37:15.2: Abhijānāti no bhante Bhagavā ahu tañ-ñeva aññatarassa mahesakkhassa yakkhassa saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimuttiṃ abhāsitthāti. --

mn37:15.4: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhikkhu saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānan-ti.
mn37:15.5: Evaṃ vutte ahaṃ Moggallāna Sakkaṃ devānaṃ-indaṃ etad-avocaṃ:
mn37:15.8: Evañ-ce taṃ devānam-inda bhikkhuno sutaṃ hoti:
mn37:15.10: so sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ abhiññāya sabbaṃ dhammaṃ parijānāti, sabbaṃ dhammaṃ pariññāya yaṃ kañci vedanaṃ vedeti, sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā,
mn37:15.11: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharati, virāgānupassī viharati, nirodhānupassī viharati, paṭinissaggānupassī viharati;
mn37:15.12: so tāsu vedanāsu aniccānupassī viharanto, virāgānupassī viharanto, nirodhānupassī viharanto,
mn37:15.13: paṭinissaggānupassī viharanto na kiñci loke upādiyati,
mn37:15.14: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati, aparitassaṃ paccattañ-ñeva parinibbāyati;
mn37:15.15: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
mn37:15.16: Ettāvatā kho devānam-inda bhikkhu saṅkhittena taṇhāsaṅkhayavimutto hoti accantaniṭṭho accantayogakkhemī accantabrahmacārī accantapariyosāno seṭṭho devamanussānanti.

mn37:15.19: Attamano āyasmā Mahāmoggallāno Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandīti. 38.
